notes: **2012 FORM CHARACTERISATION - the first 2012 filing read in this wave; this note is the map for the rest of the cycle.** VARIANT: legacy_colAB, confirmed from the page. The cover (p1) is headed '2012 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT / FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES' with the citation '(Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5)' - i.e. the '2-5' citation of the 2010 blank, NOT the undated '2-5-2' blank Poulson used in December 2010 (ADDENDUM A4). FOUR PAGES, each classified from its own printed header: p1 COVER, p2 SUMMARY PAGE, p3 SCHEDULE A - ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED, p4 SCHEDULE B - ITEMIZED EXPENDITURES MADE.
